name: state
meaning: DaffyLevel02State

name: savedState
meaning: state to return to after the burnt line (state 0xC)

name: cineBox
meaning: PROPERTY CINEBOX: entering it starts the intro cinematic; also passed to Cine_Start

name: cineSheepBox
meaning: PROPERTY CINESHEEPBOX (Cine_Start sheep box)

name: activationBox
meaning: PROPERTY ACTIVATIONBOX: game area; leaving it cancels the game; the beam applies only inside (3D test)

name: goalBox
meaning: PROPERTY GOALBOX: win zone

name: startBox
meaning: PROPERTY STARTBOX: start zone (no detection inside)

name: cine
meaning: PROPERTY CINE, CINE2 (indexed by cineIndex +0xb5)

name: cineTextBase
meaning: PROPERTY CINETEXT; line shown = string(CINETEXT + talkPhase)

name: cineFlags
meaning: PROPERTY CINEFLAGS

name: headSweepPhase
meaning: 12-bit phase, += sweepSpeed*(g_dtMs>>1)

name: headYaw
meaning: sin(phase)*maxAngle/360, applied to joint 4

name: headMaxAngle
meaning: 70 (degrees)

name: relAngleToWolf
meaning: (yawToWolf - (yaw+headYaw)) & 0xfff; in view when < 0x38. Also rotates the HUD head

name: yawToWolf
meaning: atan2 bearing + 0x800

name: curText
meaning: current line string

name: talkPhase
meaning: DaffyLevel02TalkPhase (also the CINETEXT offset)

name: cineIndex
meaning: 0 = CINE, 1 = CINE2 (set after the first cinematic)

name: detectResult
meaning: DaffyLevel02Detect from DetectWolf

name: textBurnt
meaning: PROPERTY TEXTBURNT string index (state 0xC, voice 0xD)

name: startBoxTimerMs
meaning: ms spent in startBox while running (+= g_dtMs)

name: startBoxTimeoutMs
meaning: nag threshold: 7000, or 3000 after being caught while carrying a sheep

name: voiceId
meaning: voice for the current line (0x10..0x16 Lvl-02, 0x1c..0x22 Lvl-03)

name: answerVoices
meaning: voices for the 3 dialog answers (Dialog_UpdateAnswer): {0x19,0x17,0x18} Lvl-02 / {0x1f,0x20,0x21} Lvl-03

name: isLevel2Variant
meaning: 1 when no HiddenRocks (class 0x23) exists (Lvl-02): voice set and detect order

name: textBoxRect
meaning: {50,50,412,140} for the Yes/No text box

name: gameRunning
meaning: red-light game in progress

name: gameArmed
meaning: entering startBox will start a game

name: introDone
meaning: rules cinematic seen; kept across Reset

name: challengeWon
meaning: set in SayGoalReached; talking then opens the 3-answer dialog

name: burnt
meaning: msg 0 arg 0; cleared after the burnt line

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: result of Wolf msg 0xE; unfreeze sends msg 0xF

name: startBoxNagGiven
meaning: nag (phase 9) given this stay in startBox

name: spawnRot
meaning: rot at Init; restored on game start, win and Reset

name: dialog
meaning: Dialog_Begin(first string 10, 3 answers) box, opened after a win

name: headBufToggle
meaning: alternates 0/1 each icon draw

name: headRenderBufA
meaning: head icon render buffer (ScnBody_RenderEx)

name: headRenderBufB
meaning: second head icon buffer

name: alertIconColor
meaning: index into g_samZoneColors for the icon frame; always 1

name: head
meaning: embedded ScnBody (0x64 bytes, vtable ScnBody) with model WAR_IDO_ATEROB01; yaw +0x4ce; tint +0x4d2/+0x4d4

name: headRecord
meaning: fake level record for the head (DaffyLevel02_InitHeadRecord)
